### Manasseh’s Repentance
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/manassehs-repentance
Passage: 2 Chronicles 33:10-20
Points:
- The Chronicler records Manasseh's repentance to encourage the postexilic community never to despair of God's mercy.
- If even a notoriously wicked king could be pardoned, believers can be confident God desires to show grace.
- Acknowledging personal sin is essential, but lingering excessively on guilt risks descending into spiritual hopelessness.
- Believers must look steadily to Christ and God's compassionate character, knowing He eagerly receives all who return.
